analysis.conclusion: Resource 1053 is a type03 binary resource containing primarily control/rendering data, NOT dialogue text. Only ~12% of values fall within the glyph ID range (0-1131). The remaining values (9540 above range) are binary data: coordinates, pointers, flags, or rendering parameters. Isolated katakana (ブ,ベ,ギ,ゾ,ヂ) and hiragana (ち,ぐ,べ) appear as single-character labels or markers, not as readable sentences. No kanji inference is possible from this resource.
